definitions.memoryOracle: Accept selected_style only when a valid history has a unique plurality with at least two observations; reject ties and single observations. This is defined here independently of the production memory implementation.
definitions.ungatedReference: Writes the first observed selected_style in every non-empty history. It is a deliberately simple reference, not a production baseline.
definitions.persistenceScope: All persistence measurements use createLocalRole4Repository and count repository method calls; they are not database writes or database-level guarantees.
definitions.consentScope: The benchmark verifies the existing learning-disabled gate only. It does not establish consent requirements for lifecycle persistence or live database policy enforcement.

limitations: Synthetic deterministic inputs test decision correctness, not production latency or user outcomes.
Concurrent duplicate behavior is measured with an in-process local repository and cannot establish cross-process or database atomicity.
No live Supabase/PostgreSQL credentials were used; SQL RLS tests were not executed.
